 Deni Avdija (ankle) questionable to play Wednesday 
 by Leo Sells | Trail Blazers Correspondent | Tue, Oct 20th 2026, 8:59pm EDT 
 Deni Avdija (ankle) is questionable to play in Wednesday's game against the Phoenix Suns. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Avdija is uncertain to play on Wednesday. He's officially considered questionable due to an ankle injury, and the team will make a decision about his availability closer to game time. Toumani Camara and Micah Potter (illness) will both see more work if Avdija is ruled out ahead of game time.
